safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(هل) an interrogative particle for affirmation (al-taqrīr) [Note: Or meaning قد.]; (على الإنسان) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أتى); (حين) fāʿil (agent) of أتى, nominative.
The clause «أتى ... حين» has no grammatical position: an opening clause (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «لم يكن ...» is in the position of an accusative: ḥāl (circumstantial) of الإنسان [Note: Or in the position of a nominative as naʿt (adjective) of حين, with the linking pronoun implied in it.].

* Morphology:
(حين): a noun meaning an indefinite period, long or short; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(الدهر): a noun for extended, unlimited time; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مذكور): passive participle of the triliteral ذكر; its pattern is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(من نطفة) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلقنا); (أمشاج) naʿt (adjective) of (نطفة) [Note: The adjective comes in the plural because النطفة has a plural sense, or because every part of the drop is a drop.], genitive; (الفاء) conjunction; (سميعا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the object, by making the verb carry the meaning of خلقناه; (بصيرا) a second ḥāl, accusative..
The clause «إنّا خلقنا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «خلقنا ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «نبتليه ...» is in the position of an accusative: ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of خلقنا or of the object [Note: The clause may be resumptive, and so have no grammatical position.].
The clause «جعلناه ...» is in the position of a nominative: conjoined to the clause خلقنا..

* Morphology:
(أمشاج): plural of مشج, on the pattern فعل with two fatḥas, or with fatḥa then sukūn, meaning a mixture.

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(إمّا) a particle for detailing the states; (شاكرا) ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of هديناه, accusative; (الواو) conjunction..
The clause «إنّا هديناه ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هديناه ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «إِنَّا هَدَيْناهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شاكِراً وَإِمَّا كَفُوراً ...».
Since those characterized by gratitude are few, He said «شاكرا ...», expressing it with the active participle to indicate its scarcity. As for bringing كفور in the intensive form, it is for the sake of the verse-endings, and to signal that man is seldom free of some ingratitude, so those characterized by it are many, and it occurs often from man.

* Benefits:
- (إمّا):
It is a particle of condition and detailing, and it has five meanings:
1- Doubt, as in: (جاءني إما حسن وإما حسين) "either Ḥasan or Ḥusayn came to me", when you do not know which of the two came.
1- Doubt, as in: (جاءني إما حسن وإما حسين), when you do not know which of the two came. [Translator's note: this item is printed twice in the source.]
2- Vagueness (al-ibhām), as in the saying of the Exalted: «وَآخَرُونَ مُرْجَوْنَ لِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِمَّا يُعَذِّبُهُمْ وَإِمَّا يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ ...».
3- Choice (al-takhyīr), as in the saying of the Exalted (إِمَّا أَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ نَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقى).
4- Permission (al-ibāḥa), as in (جالس إما الحسن وإما ابن سيرين) "sit with either al-Ḥasan or Ibn Sīrīn". 5- Detailing (al-tafṣīl), as in the saying of the Exalted: (إِنَّا هَدَيْناهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شاكِراً وَإِمَّا كَفُوراً).
With (إما), the speech is built — from the very beginning — on what it was brought for, whether doubt or something else; therefore it must be repeated, except rarely. With (أو), the speech opens on certainty, and then doubt or something else supervenes; and for this reason it is not repeated.

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(للكافرين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعتدنا); and (سلاسل) is denied tanwīn because it is a plural on the pattern of the furthest plurals (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ).
The clause «إنّا أعتدنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أعتدنا ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

safi-cedvel:5-10.t:
* I'rab:
(من كأس) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشربون); (عينا) badal (substitute) of (كافورا), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose governor is the preceding يشربون, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the water of a spring".. or it is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation), likewise with the omission of a muḍāf, and the clause after it is explicative.]; (بها) attached to (يشرب), by making it carry the meaning of يلتذّ "delights" or يرتوي "quenches his thirst" [Note: Or without that implication, if the pronoun refers to الكأس.. or it is attached to a ḥāl of عينا if it is a proper name in itself.. Some exegetes made the bāʾ redundant, i.e. يشربها, taking as evidence one of the readings in which the verb takes the pronoun directly.]; (تفجيرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «إنّ الأبرار يشربون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يشربون ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «كان مزاجها كافورا ...» is in the position of a genitive: naʿt (adjective) of كأس.
The clause «يشرب بها ...» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of عينا [Note: If the pronoun in (بها) refers to الكأس, the clause is a second naʿt of الكأس, in the position of a genitive.]. The clause «يفجّرونها ...» is in the position of an accusative: ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of يشرب.
7- (بالنذر) attached to (يوفون); (يوما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative..
The clause «يوفون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or giving the reason for what preceded —. The clause «يخافون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يوفون.
The clause «كان شرّه مستطيرا ...» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of (يوما).
8- (الواو) conjunction; (على حبّه) a ḥāl of the fāʿil or of the object..
The clause «يطعمون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يوفون.
9- (إنّما) the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (لوجه) attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of نطعم [Note: Or attached to (نطعمكم), and the lām is causal.]; (لا) negative; (منكم) attached to (نريد); the second (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (شكورا) conjoined to (جزاء), accusative like it.
The clause «نطعمكم ...» is in the position of an accusative: the object of speech of an implied verb of saying, which is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يطعمون, i.e. "they give food, saying: we feed you only ...".
The clause «لا نريد ...» is in the position of an accusative: ḥāl of the fāʿil of نطعمكم.
10- (من ربّنا) attached to (نخاف) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of (يوما) — an adjective that has come before the noun it qualifies —]..
The clause «إنّا نخاف ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «نخاف ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(5) مزاجها: a noun for that with which something is mixed; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(كافورا): a noun for the well-known substance of white colour and pleasant scent, and it may be the proper name of a spring of water in Paradise; its pattern is فاعول, derived from الكفر, which is covering; it was said: because it covers things with its scent.
(7) يوفون: it contains a weak-letter change by quiescence (iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn) and a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf); its original form is يوفيون..
The ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent and the ḍamma was transferred to the fāʾ before it; then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, quiescent, with the wāw.. Its pattern is يفعون.. And in it also is the regular deletion of the hamza from its beginning, for it is the imperfect of أوفى, like أكرم, so the hamza was deleted from the imperfect just as it was deleted from (يكرم).
(مستطيرا): active participle of the six-letter verb استطار, meaning "it spread", derived from flying. Al-Farrāʾ said: المستطير is المستطيل "the far-extending". Its pattern is مستفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and it contains a weak-letter change by quiescence, i.e. the making quiescent of the yāʾ.
(10) عبوسا: an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) — or a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) — from the triliteral عبس; its pattern is فعول, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(قمطريرا): a noun meaning severe, of days or of evil; its pattern is فعلليل.

* Rhetoric:
Figurative usage (al-majāz): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَوْماً عَبُوساً قَمْطَرِيراً ...».
Describing the day as frowning is figurative in two ways: that it is described by the attribute of its people, the wretched, as in their saying "your day is fasting"; or that it is likened in its severity and harm to a frowning lion or a fierce brave warrior.

safi-cedvel:11-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction, and likewise (الواو); (شرّ) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and likewise (نضرة)..
The clause «وقاهم الله ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يوفون.. [Note: In verse (7) of the surah.].
The clause «لقّاهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause وقاهم الله..
12- (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (جنّة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative..
The clause «جزاهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause وقاهم الله.
The clause «صبروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما صبروا ...) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جزاهم), and (الباء) is causal.
13- (متّكئين) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the object pronoun in (جزاهم); (فيها) attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun in متّكئين, so it is an overlapping ḥāl (mutadākhila); (على الأرائك) attached to (متّكئين); (لا) negative; (فيها) attached to (يرون); the second (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation.
The clause «لا يرون ...» is in the position of an accusative: a second ḥāl of the pronoun of جزاهم.
14- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (دانية) conjoined to متّكئين; (عليهم) attached to (دانية), meaning مائلة "inclining"; (ظلالها) fāʿil (agent) of the active participle دانية, nominative; (تذليلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative..
The clause «ذلّلت قطوفها ...» is in the position of an accusative: conjoined to دانية [Note: Or conjoined to the clause لا يرون.].
15- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (عليهم) attached to (يطاف); (بآنية) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb يطاف; (من فضّة) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (آنية); the second (قوارير) is a badal (substitute) of the first, accusative; (من فضّة) attached to a naʿt of (قوارير); (تقديرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative.
The clause «يطاف.. بآنية ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جزاهم..
The clause «كانت قواريرا ...» is in the position of a genitive: naʿt of أكواب.
The clause «قدّروها ...» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of the second قوارير [Note: Or a ḥāl of قوارير, because it is particularized by the adjective.].
17- (الواو) conjunction; (فيها) attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun of يسقون; (عينا) badal of (زنجبيلا) [Note: Or of (كأسا), accusative like it.]; (فيها) attached to a naʿt of (عينا).
The clause «يسقون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يطاف..
The clause «كان مزاجها زنجبيلا ...» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of (كأسا).
The clause «تسمّى ...» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of the second (عينا).
19- (الواو) conjunction; (عليهم) attached to (يطوف); (لؤلؤا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative..
The clause «يطوف عليهم ولدان ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يسقون.
The clause «the condition, its verb and its answer ...» is in the position of a nominative: a second naʿt of ولدان.
The clause «رأيتهم ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «حسبتهم ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(11) وقاهم: it contains a weak-letter change by conversion (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb); its original form is وقيهم: the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was turned into an alif.
(لقّاهم): it contains a weak-letter change by conversion; its original form is لقّيهم: the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was turned into an alif.
(11) (نضرة): maṣdar of the triliteral نضر, of the pattern-class نصر, the pattern-class فرح and the pattern-class كرم; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn, meaning beauty.
(سرورا): maṣdar of the triliteral سرّ, of the pattern-class نصر; its pattern is فعول, with ḍamma on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars of the verb: سرّ with ḍamma on the sīn, سرّى with ḍamma on the sīn and fatḥa on the doubled rāʾ, مسرّة with fatḥa then kasra, and مسرّة — a mīmī maṣdar — with two fatḥas.
(12) جزاهم: it contains a weak-letter change by conversion; its original form is جزيهم: the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was turned into an alif.
(13) زمهريرا: a noun meaning intense cold — it was said it is the moon in the dialect of Ṭayyiʾ —; its pattern is فعلليل.
(14) تذليلا: the regular maṣdar of the four-letter verb ذلّل; its pattern is تفعيل.
(15) يطاف: it contains a weak-letter change by conversion to suit the passive: what preceded the wāw had fatḥa, so it was turned into an alif.
(آنية): plural of إناء, a noun for a vessel; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ, and the hamza in it is converted from a yāʾ because it is final after a quiescent alif. The pattern of آنية is فاعلة, and the madda in it was originally a hamza and an alif (أأنية). [Translator's note: آنية is usually analysed as أفعلة (أأنية); the source gives فاعلة.]
(17) يسقون: it contains a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf); its original form is يسقاون: two quiescent letters met, so the alif was deleted and what preceded the wāw remained with fatḥa as an indication of the deleted letter; its pattern is يفعون, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(زنجبيلا): a noun for the well-known plant — and it is not like the ginger of this world —; its pattern is فعلليل.
(18) سلسبيلا: either the proper name of a water in Paradise, or a resembling adjective for water that is extremely smooth-flowing; it was said the bāʾ was added in it for intensiveness, so its pattern is فعلبيل, or without that addition, so its pattern is فعلليل.

safi-cedvel:20-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ثمّ) an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the first (رأيت)..
The clause «رأيت ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «رأيت (the second) ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
21- (عاليهم) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) [Note: Or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (نعيما), with a muḍāf implied, i.e. "the people of bliss and of a great kingdom", and (ثياب) is the fāʿil (agent) of the active participle عاليهم.] of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (ثياب); (خضر) naʿt (adjective) of ثياب, nominative; (إستبرق) conjoined by the wāw to ثياب, nominative; and (الواو) in (حلّوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (من فضّة) attached to a naʿt of (أساور); (شرابا) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «عاليهم ثياب ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «حلّوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause عاليهم ثياب [Note: Or in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl (عاليهم) if it is parsed as a ḥāl.].
The clause «سقاهم ربّهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause حلّوا ...
22- (لكم) attached to a ḥāl of جزاء; (الواو) conjunction..
The clause «إنّ هذا كان ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كان لكم جزاء ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar of إنّ.
The clause «كان سعيكم مشكورا ...» is in the position of a nominative: conjoined to the (first) clause كان.

* Morphology:
(21) عاليهم: either an active participle of (علا) [Note: See verse (83) of Surat Yūnus.], or it is an adverb on the pattern of the active participle, like داخل الشيء "the inside of the thing" and خارجه "its outside".
(حلّوا): it contains a weak-letter change by quiescence (iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn) and a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf).. Its original form is حلّيوا — with a yāʾ with ḍamma before the wāw —: the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent and the ḍamma was transferred to the lām before it — a weak-letter change by quiescence —; then the yāʾ was deleted because it came together, quiescent, with the wāw of the plural — a weak-letter change by deletion —; its pattern is فعّوا, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the doubled ʿayn.
(سقاهم): it contains a weak-letter change by conversion (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb) ... its original form is سقيهم — the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was turned into an alif.

* Benefits:
ثمّ is a noun used to point to a distant place, as in the saying of the Exalted: (وَأَزْلَفْنا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ). It is an adverb that is not declinable (lā yataṣarraf), and therefore whoever parsed it as the object of رأيت in the saying of the Exalted (وَإِذا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيماً وَمُلْكاً كَبِيراً) erred. The particle of attention (hā) does not precede it, and the kāf of address does not follow it.

safi-cedvel:23-26.t:
* I'rab:
(نحن) a pronoun in the position of an accusative, borrowed to emphasize the pronoun that is the noun of إنّ [Note: Or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being the clause نزّلنا, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إنّ.]; (عليك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نزّلنا); (تنزيلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «إنّا ... نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نزّلنا ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar of إنّ. 24- (الفاء) linking the answer of an implied condition; (لحكم) attached to (اصبر), by making it carry the meaning of أذعن "submit"; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive (majzūm); (منهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (آثما); (أو) a conjunction for permission (al-ibāḥa)..
The clause «اصبر ...» is in the position of a jussive: the answer of an implied condition, i.e. "if the decree of Allah comes, then be patient".
The clause «لا تطع ...» is in the position of a jussive: conjoined to the answer clause.
25- (الواو) conjunction; (بكرة) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (اذكر).
The clause «اذكر ...» is in the position of a jussive: conjoined to the answer clause.
26- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (الفاء) linking the answer of an implied condition; (له) attached to (اسجد); (ليلا) an adverb, accusative, attached to (سبّحه).
The clause «اسجد ...» is in the position of a jussive: the answer of an implied condition, i.e. "whatever happens, prostrate", and the implied condition is conjoined to the preceding implied condition.
The clause «سبّحه ...» is in the position of a jussive: conjoined to the clause اسجد.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(وراءهم) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (يوما) [Note: It means أمامهم "before them".. or it means "behind", i.e. they pay no heed to it, so it may be attached to (يذرون).].
(يوما) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «إنّ هؤلاء يحبّون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يحبّون ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «يذرون ...» is in the position of a nominative: conjoined to the clause يحبّون.

* Rhetoric:
The explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَوْماً ثَقِيلًا ...»: the day is described as heavy, likening its severity and terror to the weight of something grievous and burdensome to the one who carries it, by way of metaphor.

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(تبديلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative..
The clause «نحن خلقناهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلقناهم ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (نحن).
The clause «شددنا ...» is in the position of a nominative: conjoined to the clause خلقناهم.
The clause «شئنا ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «بدّلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(أسرهم): a noun meaning the joints and the limbs. In al-Qāmūs:
الأسر is strength, anger and strength of build, and شددنا أسرهم means "their joints". And in al-Mukhtār: أسره الله, i.e. He created him, and شددنا أسرهم, i.e. their build. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa.

safi-cedvel:29-31.t:
* I'rab:
The reference in (هذه) is to the surah; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شاء) past verb, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and likewise the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (اتّخذ); (إلى ربّه) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being اتّخذ.
The clause «إنّ هذه تذكرة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «من شاء ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «شاء ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «اتّخذ ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
30- (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative, and the object of (تشاؤون) is omitted, i.e. obedience; (إلّا) for restriction (al-ḥaṣr) [Note: Or for exception.]; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يشاء الله) is in the position of an accusative as an adverb of time, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "except at the time of Allah's will" [Note: Or in the position of an accusative as excepted from the most general of states, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "you do not will obedience in any state except in the state of Allah's will".].
The clause «تشاؤون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause من شاء.
The clause «يشاء الله ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كان عليما ...» is in the position of a nominative: khabar of إنّ.
31- (في رحمته) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يدخل); (الواو) conjunction; (الظالمين) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation), explained by what follows it, i.e. أوعد "He threatened" or عاقب "He punished"; (لهم) attached to (أعدّ)..
The clause «يدخل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «(أوعد) الظالمين ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يدخل.
The clause «أعدّ لهم ...» has no grammatical position: explicative (tafsīriyya).
